prompt: Create a serene, photorealistic vertical image of a young adult woman sitting sideways on a simple wooden chair on a sunlit balcony, reading an open paperback book and gently looking back toward the viewer. She has long dark brown softly wavy hair with bangs and wears a minimal warm beige two-piece swimsuit. Frame the scene from inside a traditional Japanese-style room or doorway, with wooden sliding door frames and translucent paper panels on the left and a warm cream stucco wall on the right, creating a natural architectural frame around the subject. The balcony overlooks a quiet rocky inlet with clear turquoise seawater, a small shrine-like wooden structure on the shore, pine trees, green hills, and the open sea in the distance. Use warm late-afternoon sunlight, soft natural shadows, a peaceful vacation atmosphere, realistic skin tones, shallow depth of field with the distant coast slightly softened, and high-end lifestyle photography composition. Keep the mood quiet and contemplative, centered on reading by the sea; no visible logos, no extra people, no modern clutter, no text overlays.
